violations.text: Per interview of the person in charge, ice scoop is not sanitized after washing and rinsing it. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. New Violation. Correct By: 03/26/2026

The sanitizing dispenser located at the 3-bay sink in the back room area was not in good repair. Per person in charge, a work order has already been placed. The person in charge called maintenance during time of inspection to request them to repair it a s soon as possible. Per person in charge, a bleach water solution will be used until sanitizing dispenser is repaired. Please email inspector proof of repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of biofilm. Establishment must clean the ice machine. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (Ice Machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice Machine is not to be used until unit is cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 11/22/2023

The door to the outside, located in the front and back of store, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/22/2023
The gasket located on the walk in cooler door two was not in good repair. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/22/2023
The floor in the walk in cooler is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2024
